Amy (Sales): quick sync — ACME wants an on‑prem airgap POC. Main asks: signed offline bundle, minimal delta updates, upgrade/rollback runbook, and a PAL (price/discount) for a 90d pilot. Who can confirm packaging options and rough $s?
Mike (Solutions): I can own packaging + runbook. Two viable bundle types: full image (single tar with operator, images, sbom, sigs) or minibundle (core runtime + model shards as separate deltas). Minibundle reduces transport but increases install steps.
John T (Acme): minibundle sounds good if we can avoid 50GB USB drops each patch. target: <5GB incremental updates. Also requirement: no outbound connections.
Olivia (PSA): Pricing: for a 90d pilot we usually do a pilot license with 30% list discount + up to 16 PS hours of remote assist included. If they want on‑site engineer it's extra. Shipping + signing fees are one‑time. I can draft numbers once we lock bundle type.
Ira (Security): questions from their sec questionnaire: 1) How do we sign bundles? 2) Cert rotation cadence? 3) Can telemetry be disabled? 4) KMS/HSM integration? Answers: we sign with our team key (Sigstore step) and provide SBOM. Rotation: recommended 90d; we support key replace flow. Telemetry: opt‑out supported for airgap. KMS: can integrate with customer HSM via offline key wrapping (requires ops).
Mike (Solutions): for delta size: with minibundle + model quantization we can hit ~3–4GB deltas for model patch only. Runtime updates will be heavier. We can compress layers and ship as chunked tar. For install we provide a single `installer.sh` and an offline cert bundle.
Mike (Solutions): sample install snippet: ```bash
# run on isolated host
./installer.sh --bundle /media/usb/acme_bundle.tar.gz --offline --accept-license
```
John T (Acme): rollback path? if an upgrade breaks we need a guaranteed fallback to previous model and runtime within 30m.
Mike (Solutions): rollback is supported if they keep the previous bundle in staging (we recommend keeping last two bundles). Our installer has a `--rollback-to <bundle-id>` flag; with operator-managed deployments it takes ~10–20m depending on images.
Olivia (PSA): commercial note: we can include up to 2 emergency patches in the pilot at no extra charge if issue is P0. After that, hourly dev/ops rates apply. Also we need an SOW addendum for airgap delivery.
Ira (Security): I'd like the sec questionnaire answers before we hand to their Infosec. Can we redact internal signing keys and provide an outline of our SBOM and verification steps?
Amy (Sales): @Mike @Ira @Olivia — can we have a one‑pager runbook + sec answers and ballpark pricing by tomorrow EOD? I'll push to ACME and loop their legal.
deploy-bot: artifact redelivery job #4782 queued: offline-bundle-acme-20240405.tar.gz (staging). See internal ticket: https://redwood.internal/t/4782
Mike (Solutions): will draft runbook and sample commands + rollback checklist. Ira will draft security answers. Olivia to sketch price. I'll ping when bundle sizes validated.
John T (Acme): thanks — also can we get an estimated lead time for signed USB shipment? 7–10 business days is ok.
Olivia (PSA): noted. shipping lead time ~8bd, signing & QA adds ~2bd. I'll include that in the SOW.
Amy (Sales): perfect. I'll book a 30m call with ACME for Wed to run through the runbook. :thumbsup:
